newsitem.title: UK: LIFFE cocoa a touch lower in brisk AA, cross trade.
newsitem.headline: LIFFE cocoa a touch lower in brisk AA, cross trade.

text.p: LIFFE cocoa futures were a touch lower in brisk business on Monday with activity centred on against actual and cross trades ahead of July's first tender day on Tuesday.
Volume reached an impressive 6,604 lots by midsession, with only about 200 lots were outright business.
July led actives with 3,380 lots traded. Three trade houses crossed 900 lots each of July positions.
"People were tidying up their positions at the end of the month and with July becoming tenderable from tomorrow," said one trader.
July open positions remained large, standing at 15,065 lots on Friday, two days before the first tender day.
July and September were four stg down each at 1,120 and 1,140 a tonne respectively at midsession.
Traders said while the overall bullish sentiment remained intact, this morning's direction was merely following which ever way the spot July moved.
But sellers were scarce with the market just trading about 20 stg away from its recent highs.
They were also cautious over the weather in Ivory Coast, which is experiencing the wettest June since 1982.
